brief:
An overwhelming majority in the UN Fourth Committee adopted three resolutions supporting UNRWA and the rights of Palestinian refugees while rejecting settlement expansion, Shehab Wire reported. The votes delivered what the committee framed as a clear international message on implementing UN decisions regarding Palestinians.

The resolutions address Palestinian refugee rights, UNRWA operations, and opposition to Israeli settlements in occupied territories. The strong backing reflects sustained diplomatic pressure within UN bodies to advance Palestinian causes through multilateral action.

title: UN committee passes three resolutions backing UNRWA and Palestinian rights
